about-us.html:
About us

Shingkhar Pvt. Ltd. is the sole and exclusive distributor of Kia Motors Corporation in Bhutan since the year 1999. As we celebrate over twenty years of the dealership, we commit ourselves to deliver exceptional customer care and satisfaction to all our customers.

Whether you’re new to Kia or you need the support of our services, our team of highly knowledgeable and skilled teams will provide you with the high-quality customer service that you deserve.

Learn more about KIA from the Kia Talent Lounge

service.html:
Welcome to Kia Service Center

We are happy to announce that our new service center at Babesa is now open. The exclusive Kia Service Center has a comprehensive selection of services ranging from the supply of Genuine Kia spare parts & accessories to diagnostic and repair of Kia vehicles will be offered to all our valued customers.

At Kia Bhutan Service Center, our highly qualified technicians are here to provide exceptional & prompt service. We are dedicated to maintaining top-tier customer service, for both new and pre-owned car buyers. Allow our staff to demonstrate our commitment to excellence. Our service center is located at Babesa, Thimphu.  

We have many trained and experienced technician who has undergone various training from Kia Motors Corporation. We offer all kinds of services like oil changes and other maintenance services as well as all significant repair services. So you are all assured of getting one-stop services with Kia Bhutan.

Experienced and factory-certified Technicians

Kia Bhutan has built a reputation for trustworthiness with local drivers. Our basic principle extends to our repair service. We’ll fix it up for you and get you back on the road as quickly as possible.

career.html:
Career

Follow your passion, Make a difference your way…
Whatever you’re passionate about, make the most of it in a career with Kia Bhutan. Whether you’re a strategic thinker, a digital innovator, a tech wizard, or a business problem solver, you’ll find an exciting career path on the cutting edge.

We’d love to get to know your unique blend of talents and help you explore and grow them further. How far will you go?

We are always looking for bright, motivated, and energetic professionals to add to our world-class team. Our distributor works as a team and our team strives to be the best for our customers. If you feel that your skills would be a valuable asset to our customers, then we want to get to know you!

Contact us for the latest employment opportunities and to schedule an interview with us.
